assignment: Write a methods note for a regional rainfall series after an instrument relocation.
source: A gauge moved from a sheltered site to an exposed site on 1 July. Its mean daily reading fell from 5.0 to 4.0 mm across the move. A nearby unchanged gauge fell from 5.5 to 5.0 mm. The comparison spans different parts of the rainy season. There were only three days with both old and new gauges running.

criteria.full: Quantifies the local drop of 1.0 mm against the comparison drop of 0.5 mm and interprets the residual cautiously.
criteria.partial: Notes both declines but fails to estimate the differential.

criteria.full: Explains seasonal/weather differences, exposure and the small overlap as constraints on attribution.
criteria.partial: Names uncertainty without identifying a specific constraint.

criteria.full: Proposes overlapping measurements or multiple reference gauges and weather-stratified diagnostics.
criteria.partial: Proposes applying a universal correction from three days alone.

criteria.full: Retains original readings, marks the break and defines separate publication of any adjusted series with uncertainty.
criteria.partial: Suggests correcting historical data without preserving its provenance.
